Class WorkoutManager

java.lang.Object
WorkoutManager
public class WorkoutManager extends Object
WorkoutManager.java The logic layer of the Workout Tracker. It holds the list of Workout objects (in memory, since there is no database in Phase 1) and does the CRUD operations plus the calorie calculation. It never prints anything. Every method returns a value so it is easy to test.

      public boolean addWorkout(Workout workout)

    • removeWorkout

      public boolean removeWorkout(int id)

    • updateWorkout

      public boolean updateWorkout(int id, String field, String newValue)
      Updates one field of one workout. The new value is checked again by the validator, so bad data can never get into the list.
      Parameters:
      id - the ID of the workout to change
      field - one of: name, duration, weight, met, completed
      newValue - the new value as text
      Returns:
      true if the workout was updated, false if the ID, field or value was bad

      public int loadFromFile(String filePath)
